name: Aggressive B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma

ethnicAssociations: Higher incidence in Caucasians and African Americans

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of diffuse proliferation of large neoplastic B-cells with high mitotic rate
Expression of B-cell markers CD19, CD20, CD22, and high Ki-67 proliferation index
Detection of MYC, BCL2, and/or BCL6 gene rearrangements by FISH or PCR
Rapidly enlarging lymphadenopathy or extranodal mass

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of diffuse large B-cell proliferation with supportive immunophenotyping
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing aids in subclassification and prognosis but is not mandatory for diagnosis

searchTerms: fast growing painless swollen lymph nodes

pathognomonic.symptomName: B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)

common.symptomName: Extranodal mass formation (e.g., gastrointestinal tract, CNS involvement)
common.notes: Common sites include stomach and CNS
searchTerms: tumor in organs like gut or CNS
fatigue related to low red blood cells
low blood counts from bone marrow disease
anemia and low platelets due to marrow infiltration

occasional.symptomName: Neurological deficits due to CNS involvement
searchTerms: neurological signs due to CNS disease
blood loss from gut lining damage

occasional.symptomName: Pleural effusion secondary to thoracic involvement

searchTerms: autoimmune destruction of red blood cells

rare.symptomName: Cutaneous involvement presenting as nodules or plaques
Severe hypercalcemia due to tumor secretion

laboratory: Anemia and cytopenias on complete blood count
imaging: CT or PET-CT showing bulky lymphadenopathy and extranodal masses
genetic: MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 gene rearrangements detected by FISH
Clonal immunoglobulin heavy chain gene rearrangement
other: Histopathology with diffuse large B-cell morphology
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD20, CD79a, and high Ki-67 index

distinguishingFeatures: Different clinical presentation with mediastinal involvement

references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Harris NL, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines for Non-Hodgkin's Lymphomas, Version 6.2023.
Orphanet: Aggressive B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. ORPHA:300846.
